headlines.title: AI boom could trigger market shocks, Bank of England boss warns
headlines.description: Andrew Bailey says the central bank is watching the waves of cash being invested in artificial intelligence "very carefully".

headlines.title: Household energy bills forecast to see biggest rise in four years
headlines.description: A typical household faces an annual gas and electricity bill of £1,999 from January, based on a key forecast.

headlines.title: Greggs to shut four factories and cut 740 jobs
headlines.description: The company says it needs to "keep evolving alongside changing customer expectations".

headlines.title: Regulating AI 'not the right place to start' says Bailey
headlines.description: AI needs "rigorous" testing and safeguards to contain risk, Andrew Bailey says.

headlines.title: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
headlines.description: The Kenya refinery is part of Dangote's ambitious bid to expand and help industralise Africa by 2030.
